claim: Patchline ships an uncertainty-decomposition separating aleatoric from epistemic risk with calibration gates. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the aleatoric claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make uncertainty-decomposition-gate`.
